notes:
## Changes

- **Choose your own downloads folder.** The downloads folder is now a setting, under **Settings > Storage > Downloads folder**. There's no default: the first time you open **Downloads In Progress** without one, Video Shelf asks you to pick the folder.
- **A folder filter that keeps up.** The **In folder** filter in Downloads In Progress shows each folder relative to your downloads folder, and updates by itself as videos arrive or go.
- **Deleted videos leave the list.** Delete, rename or move a video out of the downloads folder (or remove a whole subfolder) and it leaves Downloads In Progress straight away, along with its cached screenshots.
- **New downloads stay put.** Videos picked up while the window is open are saved straight away, so they're still there when you switch to **Today** or **Last 3 hours**, or close and reopen the window, without a refresh.
- **No more Watch folder button.** The downloads folder is always watched while the window is open, so the button wasn't needed.
